name: Homokbödöge (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of blue over yellow with a white triangle at the fly whose point reaches the centre, charged in the hoist with the municipal arms of Homokbödöge: a white shield with a yellow lion holding a sabre.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
